skeleton: earthonline-ue5-v1 (bone names); this body's own bind pose and bone axes
frames: Bones run along local +Y (as delivered). Bone axes are the delivered ones, NOT R1's. The canonical relation is boneWorld = canonicalWorld[old joint] * R[b], with R[b] = A[b] * bindWorld[b]. Equivalently boneWorld = R1boneWorld * O[b] with O[b] = R1restWorld[b]^-1 * R[b] (so a pose made for R1's skeleton converts as local[b] = O[parent]^-1 * R1local[b] * O[b]).
